# MISSION.md format

Lives at `reports/teach/<slug>/MISSION.md`. Every teaching decision traces back here.

```md
# Mission: {Topic}

## Why
{1–3 sentences. Concrete outcome — not "to understand X".}

## Success looks like
- {Observable thing the user will be able to do}

## Constraints
- {Time, budget, preferences}

## Out of scope
- {Adjacent topics they do not want now}
```

- One mission per workspace. Two topics → two slugs.
- Concrete over abstract. Interview vagueness before writing.
- Revise when the goal moves. Keep it one screen.
